Enforces system-level adult content policy, prevents tampering, and manages VPN lockdown on managed devices.
Shows ongoing status of Tarzi system-level adult filtering
Alerts when protection configuration is altered or tampered with
Lets Tarzi see and control your screen in any app

Tarzi needs screen access so it can act on your voice commands anywhere on the device — opening a video in YouTube, scrolling a page, or reading what is on screen. Tarzi only reads the screen when you ask it to do something, and never uploads screen contents unless you turn on Live Mode.
